reviews.comment: I am an animal science major and got an A on the final project, don't listen to the other reviews, he is not biased in his grading. He was an awesome professor, I would love to take another one of his classes. He genuinely cares about his students and is very passionate about teaching! As long as you show up to class/study you should be good.

reviews.comment: Incrdible professor that's passionate about teaching. As an ansc major, I don't get the reviews claiming favoritism towards food science majors. Didn't need to take final.

reviews.comment: honestly best proff i had in 3 years from the animal science department , very nice , explains things easy and clear, 3 exams that are easy , one big semester long group project, i had to drop his class not because of him because i am transferring to another uni , but this proff deserves a raise! never had a proff like him before

reviews.comment: The content covered in this class wasn't very interesting to me, but Taylor made the lectures super fun. Participation points & a few easy homework assignments to boost your grade.

reviews.comment: Dr. Taylor is an enjoyable professor who makes this known-to-be difficult class more bearable. Lots of memorization and tests get significantly harder. Hard but very interesting class!

reviews.comment: Prof Taylor is very sweet and caring. He makes dad jokes during his lectures which make them more bearable. reviews.comment: It was an okay class overall. Sometimes, I wish he'd talk more about the big picture and general concepts rather than specific details on preservatives and methods of sterilization since most of us don't have background in microbiology. He can be quite vague when he explains things too. His mood can be fickle too.

Dr. Taylor was a good prof. He does go pretty fast in his lectures, but they're very interesting! He is very passionate about what he teaches and was always super upbeat!
